parts:
I'm using "shiny_0.11.0.9001" because of the sliderInput touchscreen issues.

ui.R:

library(shiny)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  headerPanel("DEBUG"),
  fluidRow(
    column(
      12,
      plotOutput("test",clickId="testClick"),
      textOutput("testText")
    )
  )
))

server.R:
library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input,output,session) {
  output$test <- renderPlot({
    toplot <- c(1,2,3,2,3,1,5,3,2)
    barplot(toplot,main="Network Distribution (Top 5)",horiz=TRUE,cex.names=0.7)
  })
  output$testText <- renderText({
    asdf <- input$testClick
    print(asdf)
    return(paste('X',asdf$X))
  })  
}
)
